acceptanceCriteria: Identify an evidence-backed archive actor and cause, or explicitly retain unknown attribution; distinguish deliberate human archive from tool or cleanup behavior.
Document or qualify a supported archive-state/provenance check and safe recovery path for unfinished coordinated chats without automatically overriding deliberate human intent.
body:
Observed coordination friction on 2026-10-01 during the requested Corvint issue batch. Sending an authorized status update to known older-PR coordinator thread01a0f4d6-ea40-78f3-ade1-6fc6d8da731c (Orchestrate tasks and close issues) failed: session is archived. That chat retained unfinished PR355 terminal qualification and merged379 native completion; no completion or archive instruction for it was issued by this coordinator. Supported set_thread_archived archived:false succeeded, then the same message was delivered. Earlier batch checkpoints also retain restored unfinished408/412 chats and worktree/evidence preservation. The actor, reason and provenance of these archive actions remain UNKNOWN: this does not establish an app defect or rule out deliberate user action. Do not attribute it to another cleanup chat without evidence. Expected: archive actions affecting active/unfinished dispatch owners are explicit or auditable and do not silently interrupt coordination; actual: sender discovers the archive only on a failed message, while read_thread reports notLoaded. Reproduction uses read_thread/send_message_to_thread on the known ID and supported unarchive. Tool/runtime app version NOT_OBSERVED; installed Core163 and Tasks202. Evidence is in coordinator chat01a0f2a2-7c1c-7af2-acce-0f7cabb8ce0f and dispatch.json. Preserve unfinished work and honor explicit human archive intent; investigate before changing lifecycle behavior.

Additional observed cases, 2026-10-01: existing unfinished corpus399/397 chat01a0f2aa-89d0-7380-9a17-f48e25357aed required supported restoration twice during retained qualification preparation; Hide Corvint context JSON chat01a0f71a-e71b-7002-896a-9f77bb7b3ac7 rejected authorized access coordination while nativeV1-0590 OPEN, and companion394 chat01a0f2aa-7a1c-7423-a90f-b20d42647df3 rejected the directly human-authorized follow-up while native0556/0541 and technical acceptance remained OPEN. Supported unarchive and retry delivered messages. Current root human grant call_onhyy4lJ6D5TxGEGbAWbWbtr explicitly permits the four existing issue-chat messages through completion; Hide access grant call_5G40oKyt51PzXtNEgXiT0zig is retained. Archive actor/cause and app version remain UNKNOWN, and deliberate human archive is not ruled out. Source, worktrees, native claims and evidence were preserved. No lifecycle behavior change implemented. Root grants/artifacts: root-existing-issue-chats-owner-authorization.json, root-shared-access-owner-authorization.json, corpus-baseline-preparation-handoff.json; direct tool errors and supported recoveries in root window01a0f793-7de7-7691-ba88-e919898cc573.
title: Codex coordination: determine why unfinished batch chats become archived
